a: Up to $300,000 in total, including 15% overhead, for 2 to 4 years, shared by the US and Israeli partners
dt: Applications due Dec 2, 2026, 5 pm Israel time (10 am ET), submitted through the institution; the exact and physical sciences are open only in even years
e: Joint grants for a US and an Israeli scientist who collaborate on basic research; the 2026 competition covers the exact and physical sciences, including physics (astronomy, astrophysics and cosmology among its areas). Both PIs must hold a PhD or equivalent and a faculty or equivalent post at a non-profit institution; graduate students and postdocs cannot apply.
n: US-Israel BSF Research Grants: Exact and Physical Sciences (2026 competition)
unv: bsf.org.il blocked automated access (HTTP 403) on Oct 21, 2026. The Dec 2, 2026 deadline, the $300,000 cap and the even-year rule come from search results of BSF's 2026 submission regulations, homepage and area-of-research page, and match Yale's InfoReady listing; BSF's calendar and area-of-research page were also indexed with Nov 18, 2026, so confirm the date with BSF.

yale.t: Not a limited submission. Yale applicants should contact Zandra Ruiz (zandra.ruiz@yale.edu), Corporate and Foundation Relations, before applying.
